papers.title: Quintessential Inflation in Light of ACT DR6
papers.abstract: We analyze the canonical generalized-exponential quintessential-inflation potential in light of ACT DR6 scalar-tilt constraints and the distinct demands of its post-inflationary and late-time evolution. The potential slow-roll hierarchy is derived through fourth order and checked against a numerical scalar and tensor mode calculation. For a benchmark $n=15$, $\lambda=10^{-9}$ at a reference $60$ remaining e-folds, the numerical spectrum gives $n_s\simeq0.96396$, $r\simeq7.71\times10^{-5}$, and a negative running of running of order $10^{-5}$. The exact Hubble-flow endpoint gives a full inflationary excursion exceeding $M_{\rm Pl}$ even though the ten-e-fold observable interval is much smaller. We characterize a phenomenological radiation-injection family followed through kination, radiation and matter domination, and calculate leading-order gravitational-wave transfer spectra with an integrated radiation-density test. A shallow exponential term permits a calibrated late-time quintessence phase, whose homogeneous equation of state and expansion predictions are evaluated numerically. The result is a quantitative map of the coupled inflation, reheating, gravitational-wave and dark-energy requirements, with the limitations of the assumed transfer and thermal history stated explicitly.

papers.title: Finite Standard-Model Carrier from Timelike Codazzi Defects
papers.abstract: The inverse problem of whether protected data carried by a local Lorentzian defect can determine a finite internal gauge-and-matter carrier before microscopic dynamics are chosen is considered. For a codimension-three timelike Codazzi defect, a marking-preserving reconstruction fixes a five-dimensional complex carrier $V=C\oplus W$ with $\dim_{\mathbb C}(C,W)=(3,2)$, the global gauge form $S(U(3)\times U(2))$, a chiral $16$-dimensional exterior packet with $k_Y=5/3$, and a norm-seven family structure. The chiral packet has the standard algebraic $SU(5)$-Spin$(10)$ envelope without assuming grand unification. Within a declared regularized-domain class, one constrained microscopic realization is constructed. Its distinguished branch ends at a single intrinsic terminal where the strict charge minimum and the first simple invariant-sector fixed-charge degeneracy coincide; soft-coupled readouts acquire a rank-one critical-response pole. On the rank-two exact-five moment stratum, four native matrix moments reconstruct a five-dimensional cyclic operator up to hidden unitary. The resulting scale-free observables lie on a one-dimensional solution manifold with a discrete conjugate orientation. With $W/Z$ used to set its longitudinal coordinate, direct CKM and reactor/solar data are consistent with the same manifold, while first-row CKM normalization remains a separate transverse structural test. Existence within the stated class is established, not uniqueness. A blind determination of the longitudinal coordinate still requires the unresolved centered-response incidence; physical transport remains an independent microscopic gate.
